source: ESA WorldCover consortium (VITO), hosted on AWS Open Data Registry
source_url_note: Tile naming is by 3x3-degree SW-corner grid. Mumbai (~18.9-19.3N, 72.7-73.0E) falls in tile N18E072. VERIFY exact tile filename against the grid file before downloading: https://esa-worldcover.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/esa_worldcover_grid.geojson
temporal_resolution: static, 2021 (v200); a 2020 v100 edition also exists
coverage: One 3x3-degree tile (N18E072) fully covers Mumbai + the requested 5-10km buffer with large margin
file_size: each WorldCover tile is roughly 500MB-1GB (117GB total dataset across 2651 tiles globally; one tile is a small fraction)
limitations: No authentication needed, but the file is large for a single tile - a full 3x3deg GeoTIFF at 10m, not pre-clipped to Mumbai. Clip to the Mumbai+buffer bbox after download to save space.
processing: NONE - keep original classification raster as instructed; do not convert to imperviousness here.
notes: 11-class land cover: tree cover, shrubland, grassland, cropland, built-up, bare/sparse veg, snow/ice, permanent water bodies, herbaceous wetland, mangroves, moss/lichen.
